- agents.md:456-464 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The seven new `WORKTREE_*` stable prefixes are inserted before the existing `drift-audit:` and `CHECK_TRIAGE` entries, violating the append-only contract.
  WHY: Reordering pre-existing stable-prefix entries breaks the documented ordering invariant that downstream tooling expects.
- agents.md:559-565 | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The `LOG_PREFIX.name=WORKTREE_*` entries are inserted before `LOG_PREFIX.name=drift-audit:` and `LOG_PREFIX.name=CHECK_TRIAGE` instead of being appended at the end.
  WHY: Reordering the existing LOG_PREFIX.name registry violates the same append-only stability contract.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:lines 22-38 (removed emit_event bootstrap), line ~1220 (removed emit_event call) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `emit_event` bootstrap block and the `emit_event()` call for `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK` were both removed.
  WHY: With `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED=true`, `.events/run-*.jsonl` will miss the `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK` record and the regression test will fail.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:lines 1-19 (removed emit_event bootstrap), lines 12-27 (`_semble_log_event` no longer calls `emit_event`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `emit_event` bootstrap and the `emit_event()` call inside `_semble_log_event()` were both removed.
  WHY: `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` is no longer mirrored to `.events/run-*.jsonl`, so the regression test will fail.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:lines 19-31 (removed emit_event bootstrap), lines ~52-67 (`emit_serena_fallback` no longer calls `emit_event`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `emit_event` bootstrap and the `emit_event()` calls inside `emit_serena_fallback()` were removed.
  WHY: `SERENA_FALLBACK` is no longer mirrored to `.events/run-*.jsonl`, so the regression test will fail.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:lines 11-21 (removed emit_event import and _mirror_event), lines ~131-138 (`emit_rollups` no longer calls `_mirror_event`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `_emit_event_helper` import and `_mirror_event()` function were removed, and `emit_rollups()` no longer mirrors `SERENA_QUERY` into `.events/run-*.jsonl`.
  WHY: The Python-based regression test will miss the `SERENA_QUERY` record and fail.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:lines 10-38 (removed emit_event import and _mirror_event), lines ~83-103 (`_emit_probe_line` no longer calls `_mirror_event`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `_emit_event_helper` import and `_mirror_event()` function were removed, and `_emit_probe_line()` no longer mirrors `SERENA_PROBE` into `.events/run-*.jsonl`.
  WHY: The Python-based regression test will miss the `SERENA_PROBE` record and fail.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:lines 84-94 (removed emit_event import and _mirror_event), lines ~154-174 (`_log_semble_event` no longer calls `_mirror_event`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `_emit_event_helper` import and `_mirror_event()` function were removed, and `_log_semble_event()` no longer mirrors SEMBLE_* output into `.events/run-*.jsonl`.
  WHY: This silently disables Phase D event mirroring for the targeted file context module when `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED=true`.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/semble_helpers.sh, scripts/setup_serena.sh, scripts/serena_stats_emit.py, scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py, scripts/targeted_file_context.py:Each file's removed emit_event bootstrap/call blocks | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: These six files all had their `emit_event` bootstrap and mirror calls removed as part of the same refactor.
  WHY: The `test_log_prefix_regressions.sh` test will fail `assert len(records) == 5` because records are missing from `.events/run-*.jsonl`.
- scripts/worktree_registry.sh:_worktree_registry_emit function (lines 100-110) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The stable-prefix emitter writes to stdout instead of stderr, which is inconsistent with other helpers in the repository.
  WHY: Downstream tooling expects stable-prefix emitters to write to stderr; stdout contamination can break log parsers and event-mirroring behavior.
- scripts/worktree_gc.sh:main function jq guard (lines 53-57) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The jq guard exits 0 without invoking registry GC when jq is missing.
  WHY: Stale worktrees accumulate indefinitely because GC is skipped entirely in environments where jq is missing or unavailable.
- scripts/worktree_registry.sh:worktree_registry_register lines 303-310, worktree_registry_deregister lines 349-355 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Closing file descriptor 9 with `exec 9>&- || true` when the descriptor was never opened emits "Bad file descriptor" noise to stderr on early failure paths.
  WHY: That stderr noise can confuse log parsers treating registry output as structured data.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
